Hi @geraldcombs! Here is the merge request for the above mentioned issues:
https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/19265

1. The first part of the check is indeed unneccessary, so it had been removed.
2. `Expression "(uint64_t)val << 8"` was copied from the unin32_t solution (line 404), which is working perfectly, that is why that pattern was followed.
3. `length` can not be 0 since it is checked before calling the entire function in both cases. That is why the assert has been added to the beginning, to be sure that this is not possible.
